proposal.reason: Main change adds a new GIN backend/plugin (TROCE) with host/device GIN implementation, plugin export/discovery, new GIN type/device IDs, and SignalSet semantics under the GIN API. Added network review is needed because shared IB transport/proxy paths are substantively changed (provider detection, QP inline behavior, GDR checks, and IB send/atomic signaling behavior for SignalSet), which belongs to network rather than GIN-only plugin wiring.
